reviews.text: There's a veterinarian named Patricia Meyer who is completely unprofessional. I was already a client of the clinic and I arrived desperate; my dog ​​had been seen the day before and was very ill. Instead of helping me, she locked herself in the office and stayed on the phone badmouthing me, and I could hear it from the reception area. I left and will never go back.
Very good, the attention from the veterinarians was excellent.

The service was exceptional, from the WhatsApp conversations to the in-person service. My very furry pet received a bath and hygienic grooming treatment that was absolutely fantastic. Thank you for the care you gave my Nando.
Excellent service from the veterinarians. The assistants were very attentive.
Excellent service. Lola loves Aunt Tayná!
Excellent service and love for animals.
I always take my dogs there. Good service and good professionals. Consultations, exams, and surgeries.
The veterinarian was very helpful, my cat recovered perfectly, and we received updates via WhatsApp throughout the entire process. I'm very satisfied!
Excellent service
Excellent
Horrible!!!!! I'm in a veterinary emergency, needing help and information, and they're unable to assist. They answer and hang up. The phone works fine, but you can tell they're unwilling to help.

I visited the clinic today for the first time and my printers were wonderful. I intentionally went on Dr. Milena's day, influenced by the comments, and I was extremely satisfied… The receptionist is also a wonderful person. Welcoming professionals…

I would like to thank and praise the entire Grandvet team, from the emergency care my dog ​​Ruby received from Dr. Jorge, who was extremely attentive and accurate after a series of trips to other places. He promptly referred me to the oncology specialist, Dr. Alexandre, who proved to be extremely professional and experienced. That same week they expedited the surgical procedure, where Dr. André gave me all the instructions and, together with Dr. Alexandre, they performed the procedure. Dr. Jorge always kept me updated, and Ruby's recovery was very good. You can see that the whole team is committed and values, above all, the well-being of our animals and their love for them. I thank the entire team, including the nurses, who were all excellent!

Complete facilities and excellent service from Dr. Jorge Erlan! My kitten had to undergo serious surgery after swallowing a foreign object, and I was able to have all the treatment done at the clinic itself. She is recovering well, and I am sure that the attention and care from Dr. Jorge and his team were essential for her good recovery!

I took my pet there and the doctor treated us with great care and patience. I am very grateful to the doctor who took such good care of my pet and gave him all the attention possible for his recovery.

Good afternoon
I love Grand Vet and all the professionals and nurses
Fifi and Thor are always very well cared for by Dr. Andre's team
It's been ten years of total trust
Thank you
Grand Vet🐶😻
Excellent service!!!

I took my dog ​​in because he was limping on his left paw, and they immediately performed X-rays of six parts of his body, resulting in a cost of R$480.00 just for the X-rays. I was then informed that my dog ​​had a very serious spinal problem and should start acupuncture immediately, even though this assessment was not done by an orthopedist. They prescribed very expensive medications. The entire treatment cost R$1000.00. I found everything strange and got the feeling that the clinic is more concerned with charging and making money than caring for our pets. I sought out an orthopedic specialist, and the diagnosis was completely different. Now my furry friend is in good hands.
Wonderful clinic

I would like to acknowledge the excellent work and service offered by Grandvet, which has a good structure and complete services.
In particular, I would like to highlight the competence, technical excellence, empathy, and welcoming attitude of Dr. Erica, Dr. Jorge Erlan, and nurse Fábio, who on numerous occasions dedicated themselves to their work with great professionalism and love in caring for my pet, making all the difference to my dog's health and quality of life, as well as to the peace of mind of the owners.
Grand vet tijuca

I was treated in the emergency room for my kitten, and the administrative and technical team was extremely attentive and well-prepared. Although it was late for my pet, they did everything possible and provided unwavering support; they were incredibly ethical and professional.
First-rate service, I recommend it.
Rude service

I am very impressed with the excellent treatment from Dr. Jorge Erlan; I have never found such a dedicated, competent, and caring veterinarian at this clinic!
Special mention also to the nurses, they are all incredible!
Special mention also to Dr. Monica, the acupuncturist, who is very caring and attentive to my elderly dog!
I feel completely safe with my dog ​​there!

I've been taking my dog ​​to this clinic for 7 years - Dr. Gabriela has been her care ever since! ❤️
You can see the amount of affection and care they have for her!
From clinical consultations to surgeries - I highly recommend them!
Dr. Gabriela is a true angel in our lives!

Thank you, GrandVet!

I can only express my gratitude to veterinarian/acupuncturist Monica Christina for her dedication and the excellent work she has done with my cat Aninha, who is 20 years old and, thanks to Monica's care, is doing very well despite her age. Thank you!

Dr. Monica is wonderful! She takes care of my pets with so much affection, and they love her care. Her attention to detail during vaccinations and handling is exceptional! I always highly recommend her!

I don't know the clinic, but I would like to say that I know Dr. Monica, the acupuncturist. She is an excellent professional, careful and responsible. She treats my pet at home, and I can only thank her for all the affection and care she has given my little one for the past 2 years.

My little dog, named "Astro," is 14 years and 3 months old. He has been treated at Grand Vet for 14 years, and we can only express our gratitude for the competence, professionalism, and welcoming atmosphere that are the hallmarks of this clinic, which takes the care of my dear friend so seriously.

I thank all the clinic staff, but I must express my special thanks to Dr. Gabriela, Dr. Érica, Dr. Mônica, Dr. André, Dr. Erlan, Dr. Patrícia, and Dr. Nídia, as well as Marcelo and Anderson representing Administration and Nursing.

We send you all a big hug and may God bless you.

José Aguiar and Astro
Excellent service and location, qualified professional, I recommend.

I was not well attended to by the acupuncturist recommended by the veterinarian. My dog ​​didn't improve at all! He just cries in pain, and we received no help from Dr. Mônica (the acupuncturist) or anyone else at the clinic. There was one session I booked a week in advance, and I waited 10 minutes to be seen. She left me alone with my dog ​​crying in pain, and the acupuncture needles were falling out because she was attending to another dog instead. In the end, I paid R$130 for the entire session, and my dog ​​left worse than before. All that mattered was the payment, while my pet, my four-legged son, was still crying in pain as I left the session. I wouldn't go back even for free!

On December 28th, my dog ​​was hospitalized at this clinic. When it was time to leave, the employee kept stalling before returning my dog, silencing him even though he was crying a lot when he heard me. I recorded everything and will post it online later. He kept judging me, thinking I wouldn't pay. I'm the mother of two doctors; I don't need this. I just think this whole "woke" thing is getting annoying. Zero stars for this clinic.

I would like to express my gratitude to the Grandvet team. I needed to leave my beloved pet hospitalized for 24 hours due to gastroenteritis, and the service was top-notch! My main contact was with Dr. Jorge, oh! He has a way of charming clients! So much affection, love, and care for our pets 🥰 He sent me videos to ease the longing..., so I could see my baby eating..., in short, I became a client, it was an incredible experience I had there.
Tobias arrived home feeling great and already asking for food 🤩

The clinic is very well-equipped, super clean, and the service is excellent, from the receptionists to the nurses and veterinarians.
A special compliment to Dr. Patrícia, who is almost my angel, or rather, my cats' angel. Another person who saved me was Dr. André, the clinic's owner.

I can only thank them and recommend them.

The WhatsApp customer service is somewhere between sad and useless.
They simply don't respond, and when they do, they give incomplete information.
It's pointless to have a customer service channel if you don't adequately respond to people interested in your company's services. Besides being frustrating, you simply lose the opportunity to make money and, especially in the case of a veterinary clinic, to build customer loyalty, since animals need vaccinations, etc., annually.

Nobody deserves this… thank goodness we have competition!

I needed hospitalization twice for my cats who, unfortunately, were already terminal. It was the place I chose for the end of their beautiful little lives. Both in 2014 (with one cat) and in 2024 (another cat), the service was welcoming, allowing me to visit, get to know the place, and say goodbye afterward.
I just think that the way they informed me about my cat's passing over the phone could have been more careful. They gave the news in the very first sentence, after the hello.
But the staff is super caring with the animals.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Guilherme! We're always working to improve!

Lack of professionalism and organization!! On December 23rd, I scheduled a bath and grooming appointment for my cat. They asked simple questions, and I answered them all via WhatsApp. I was then scheduled for January 2nd at 4:30 PM. I emphasize that I prioritized this clinic because a friend of mine takes her pet there, and I chose not to schedule elsewhere! However, today, January 2nd, 2025, 40 minutes before the bath and grooming appointment, the person in charge contacted me asking several questions that were not asked during the scheduling process. He said he was used to grooming docile cats, and I informed him that my cat was not docile, but was already used to bath and grooming. The place we usually take her always does a complete grooming session, but because they were fully booked, we didn't take her there! The gentleman informed me that the assistant was not present at that time and that it would not be possible to do the grooming without help. I asked if the assistants would be present the next day, and he said yes, but that they were only available on January 14th. IN OTHER WORDS, THEY DON'T PLAN, THEY DON'T SCHEDULE THINGS PROPERLY, AND THEY DON'T OFFER A SOLUTION. MY CAT WAS SUPPOSED TO BE GROOMED TODAY, AND THEY EVEN MESSED UP MY SCHEDULE BY MAKING AN APPOINTMENT ELSEWHERE. My parents took my cat, and after 10 minutes the gentleman informed us that it wouldn't be possible to continue, only with sedation for the cat, rescheduling for a week later and charging an extra 100 reais for the sedation! An absurdity and a total lack of professionalism. I do not recommend them and will never return. I can even understand the numerous complaints you have on Reclame Aqui! TERRIBLE!

I couldn't let the last day of the year pass without reviewing the incredible service at the clinic. Thank you to everyone who welcomed us and cared for our little Lakinha. Especially Dr. Érica and Dr. Jorge Erlan, who took such good care of both Lakinha and us every day we were there. Thank you for everything, and may 2025 be even more blessed!
Competent professionals, from the receptionists and assistants to the doctors. My sincere thanks, especially to Dr. Jorge Erlan and Dr. Emerson.

Whenever I need to go there, I receive excellent care. The last time was with Dr. Andrei, a neurologist, who examined my four-legged son, who is almost 19 years old, with great care and always answers my questions about treatment via WhatsApp. I am also very grateful to Dr. Gabriela, who is a lovely person, very patient and caring.
Excellent service! Everyone was very attentive. My special thanks to Andrei. Pompom, Mingau, and the whole family are his number one fans.

I love the clinic! My four-legged children are always very well treated there, I have a lot of confidence in their work. And we are always well attended to. Since the first time we went there, Dr. Andrei has been taking care of my pets… I always make a point of going when he is seeing patients. He answers all our questions and is always available to help and guide us in whatever is needed. I highly recommend it!

My safe haven during those Rio nights with dogs at home. I've always received excellent care and always returned home with my pets healthy. The clinic gives me complete peace of mind regarding my pets. I highly recommend it!
Thank you so much, Maria! The GRANDVET family is grateful!

The clinic itself is very good, new, well-maintained equipment, and the price is good! But I didn't like the veterinarians' service. I rescued a stray cat and took her there immediately. They didn't weigh the cat, they only deduced her weight during the two consultations I went to. They prescribed a very expensive supplement that, I later learned from another veterinarian, was unnecessary for the cat I rescued, according to her blood test. Her prescription was entirely based on weight deduction. They only weighed her when I asked, and it was inside the carrier, with the veterinarian again deducting the weight of the carrier and, consequently, deducting the cat's weight. Furthermore, they dismissed the Whiskas sachet when I mentioned that it was what I was offering the cat (it's what I can afford). I don't remember which veterinarian treated her, but he kept talking about how well his purebred cats were treated and only ate the best; I found it arrogant, I felt humiliated. On the other hand, Everton, who does the X-rays, is wonderful! I won't demonize the entire service at this clinic since I only had two visits, but they were enough for me not to want to take my cat there again.
Thank you very much Therezinha on behalf of the entire GRANDVET team.

The last month has been very painful for my family. Our dog, Jolie, my family's companion for almost 16 years, passed away. As soon as we realized the end was near, we chose GrandVet for support, not only from a clinical standpoint, because …
Hi Juliana, thank you for your feedback! I'll pass it on to everyone on our team!

If it's an emergency, DO NOT take your dog to Gran Vent! I took my dog ​​there on September 26, 2024, because she wouldn't eat and was having a lot of trouble breathing, and they only recommended hospitalization the next day, after I …
